normalization: lowercase; keep Unicode letters/marks and digits; replace others with spaces; collapse whitespace
stopword_matching: case-insensitive; longest phrase first; raw word boundaries; internal whitespace only; collapse whitespace after removal
combined_stopwords: tokenize each normalized stopword using the same language tokenizer; match longest token sequence
empty_records: preserve all IDs; report empty records; evaluator must use the same queries for every variant
